a:

while it may help if you think of a word as "the XXXXX in english", it's probably best not to try to explain that word as comprehensively as you might try to; XXXXX means "the process of catalysing".
so, XXXXX means "the process of catalysing" (which is to say, something that causes catalysis).
while that definition's a bit vague, it's certainly the right one. and, more importantly, it's not the only possible definition for XXXXX - consider your question's phrasing.
